Encore 0.5.0: Encore now updates itself, plus bookmarks, folders, an A–B loop,
a sleep timer, monthly stats and much more.

## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Encore_0.5.0_universal.dmg` |
| Windows 10 and 11 | `Encore_0.5.0_x64-setup.exe` (or the `.msi`) |
| Debian 12+, Ubuntu 22.04+ | `Encore_0.5.0_amd64.deb` |
| Other Linux (glibc 2.35+) | `Encore_0.5.0_amd64.AppImage` |

## First launch

These builds are not code-signed yet.

- **macOS:** open the app once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy &
  Security** and choose **Open Anyway**. macOS asks once for access to your
  saved session in the Keychain.
- **Windows:** SmartScreen warns on first run. Choose **More info**, then
  **Run anyway**. If Smart App Control is on, Windows blocks the app.

This is the last version you need to download by hand. Updating from 0.4.0
keeps your session, settings, downloads and player components.

## What's new

- **Encore updates itself.** It checks for new versions a few times a day,
  downloads them in the background and installs them the next time you quit,
  or right away with **Restart to update**. It never restarts on its own.
  Turn automatic updates off in **Settings → Updates** and it only tells you
  when a version is out. The `.deb` can't update itself, so Encore links you
  to the new one instead.
- **Bookmarks** for playlists, albums, artists, songs, or a moment in a song
  (<kbd>B</kbd>). They live in **Library → Bookmarks**.
- **Folders** for your playlists and albums in the sidebar, with your own
  cover. Share one as a small file.
- **Loop a part of a song**: press <kbd>A</kbd> at the start and the end, or
  Shift-drag on the seek bar, then drag the handles.
- **Sleep timer** in the player bar: after a set time, at the end of the song
  or at the end of the queue, with a gentle fade.
- **Private session**: for an hour or until you quit, plays stay out of your
  YouTube history, Last.fm and Discord.
- **Your listening, month by month** in **History → Stats**: minutes, top
  songs, artists and albums, when you listen, and what's new to you.
- **Better shuffle**: every song in a playlist plays once before any repeats,
  even across restarts.
- **Autoplay off means only what you choose plays**, including when you
  shuffle an artist.
- **Find, sort and select** in any playlist or album (<kbd>⌘F</kbd>): sort by
  title, artist, album, length, release year or your plays; add many songs to
  several playlists at once, remove, like, download or queue them.
- **Duplicates**: Encore finds extra copies in your playlists and removes them
  in one go, leaving the originals.
- **Queue tools**: time left, move songs up and down, save and restore a
  queue, or save it as a playlist.
- **Don't play this again** for a song or an artist, and **Hide podcasts**.
- **Full discography** on artist pages, and playlists made by listeners.
- **Song details** with the song's tempo and key, estimated from the file.
- **Last.fm scrobbling** with your own Last.fm API key.
- **Wikipedia** on artist pages that have no description.
- **Cover ambience**: a soft wash of the cover behind the now playing panel.
- **⌘K** finds more: type `>` for commands, `#` for your playlists and
  folders, `@` for artists, or a time like `2:15` to jump there.

## Fixes

- Encore keeps daily backups of its library database and restores the newest
  one if the database is damaged.
- Long playlists load at a steady pace instead of all at once, which YouTube
  is less likely to treat as a bot.
- Seeking back in the last seconds of a song works again.
- Quitting always saves your queue and position first.

Encore is unofficial and not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
